Chapter 1: The Lantern Ferry

This short adventure is original synthetic test text written for Kit. It is not from any published book.

1. Ferry Landing
> Rain hisses on a tarred plank landing. A rope bell hangs from a crooked post, and a flat-bottomed ferry knocks against the pilings.
> Up the bank, a stone tollhouse shows one lit window.
Oswin Tarr, a nervous ferryman, waits under the eaves. He will not cross tonight unless paid three silver.
A path climbs the bank to area 2. The ferry itself crosses to area 4.
The bell rope is frayed; a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check pulls it loose.

2. Tollhouse
> The tollhouse smells of wet wool and lamp oil. A ledger lies open on a high desk beside a cold stove.
Two bandits sit in the back room playing knucklebones. They attack anyone who touches the ledger.
A secret hatch under the stove drops to area 3. The door back down the bank leads to area 1.
The ledger records a payment of forty gold to someone called the Lantern Wight.

3. Smugglers Cellar
> Black water stands ankle deep. Crates are stacked on a ledge above the waterline.
The Lantern Wight (see the Lantern Wight stat block) waits here, and so does a marsh hag (see the Monster Manual).
A narrow ladder climbs back to area 2.
The crates hold twelve bolts of dry silk worth 10 gp each.

MAP: Lantern Ferry

4. Far Shore
> Reeds rattle against the hull as the ferry grounds on a shingle beach.
A reed lurker (see the Reed Lurker stat block) hides in the shallows and lunges at anyone who wades in. The ferry returns to area 1.

Appendix: Creatures

Lantern Wight
Medium undead
Armor Class 13
Hit Points 27 (5d8 + 5)
Speed 30 ft.
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11
Actions. Lantern Lash. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) fire damage.
The wight cannot cross running water and avoids the ferry.

Reed Lurker
Large beast
Armor Class 12 (natural armor)
Hit Points 22 (4d10)
Speed 10 ft., swim 30 ft.
Multiattack. The lurker makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.
Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Mud Spray (Recharge 5-6). Each creature in a 15-foot cone must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.
